name: rate-limits
description: Writes the account's rate-limit windows (five_hour, seven_day) and the account they belong to into ~/.claude/local/rate-limits.json on every measurement, for the weekly readout fleet-launch.sh prints before dispatching; keeps a per-session history of every window move and every login switch for fleet-metrics.py's peak 5-hour reading; and on a machine that rotates accounts (cswap present) pins the active account and its windows under the prompt

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Write the reading on every measurement that carries one. Off writes nothing and pins nothing.

status.title: Account status line on a rotating machine
status.description: Pin the active account and its 5h/7d use under the prompt where cswap's backup directory exists. Off still records the account in the files.
